newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Stock Exchange elects Yulo new chief.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Stock Exchange elects Yulo new chief.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) has elected elected businessman Jose Luis Yulo Jr as its new president, the exchange said on Tuesday.
Yulo is currently president of the government's Philippine International Trading Corp (PITC) and a founding member and former president of the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

"In choosing Yulo, a non-broker, the Board and members of the PSE will ensure that PSE continues to maintain and improve its high standards of efficiency and integrity," the exchange said in a statement.
Yulo replaces Vitaliano Nanagas who resigned from his post on March 8 five months after taking on the job. PSE said Nanagas quit because of conflicts with his staff.
